name: Remitano
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Due to the failure to take effective measures against user complaints, XRP buyers have suffered a lot of losses. The cryptocurrency exchange Remitano has announced that it has suspended all XRP deposits and withdrawals to solve the problem of false XRP deposits.
